cohort.rule: All patch-ok AND query-ok objects reported at snapshot time, preserving original splits and ordering.

windsor.metric: Mean over held-out cars of area-weighted RMSE(Cp) / area-weighted std(Cp).
windsor.selection: Independent best validation checkpoint/LR for every architecture, initialization and budget on seed 0; repeat chosen LR on seeds 1,2.
windsor.splits: Original Figure 2 nested car subsets; no new split or pressure interpolation.
